claim: On a Network Load Balancer, a deregistering target changes to unused after 300 seconds by default; you can change this deregistration delay, and AWS recommends a value of at least 120 seconds so that requests complete. For QUIC traffic the value is always 300 seconds and can't be adjusted.

qualifiers.scope: per Network Load Balancer target group
qualifiers.condition: not adjustable for QUIC traffic (always 300 seconds)

evidence.quote: By default, the load balancer changes the state of a deregistering target to `unused` after 300 seconds.
To change the amount of time that the load balancer waits before changing the state of a deregistering target to `unused`, update the deregistration delay value.
We recommend that you specify a value of at least 120 seconds to ensure that requests are completed.
For QUIC traffic the value is always 300 seconds, and can't be adjusted.
